Dialogs and drawers (1)
Transfer reviewed content
  • Included definitions/assets/keys, excluded learner data and new draft destinations
  • No enrollment, submissions, grades, feedback, staff access, allowances, attendance or live SIS transfer
Return without applying changesApply reviewed local content operation
Permissions
  • Instructor alone imports/exports authorised reusable course content.
  • TA, student and guest cannot obtain staff keys or course packages; no institution migration or grade integration controls.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Imported content is unpublished until normal authoring checks pass.
  • Package errors never overwrite existing course items or immutable work.
  • Export is a local content download, with no claim of live SIS grade delivery or third-party compatibility.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
